title: LinkLayer.send hangs forever when CAD leaves frame queued
description: LinkLayer._send_locked awaits its reservation after drain_tx_queue returns false on repeated busy CAD, but drain_tx_queue never resolves queued reservations on that path. The existing test test_set_sequence_rejects_queued_frame therefore hangs instead of returning false. Resolve the per-send reservation false without removing the queued frame, preserve later drain behavior, and add focused completion/queue-state coverage.
